info.name: Raise Hand API (HW4 · JWT, roles)
info.description:
Live Q&A for lectures — Django REST Framework + SimpleJWT + PostgreSQL in Docker Compose.

Run the whole collection with the Runner (or newman): folder 1 registers a student and a lecturer and stores their tokens in collection variables; the lecturer token is the collection's default Bearer token, individual requests switch to the student or admin token to demonstrate 401/403; folder 6 signs in as the demo admin and deletes the throw-away accounts.

Variables: baseUrl, demoPassword (DEMO_PASSWORD from .env, used only for the admin), the rest are filled automatically.

Docs: {{baseUrl}}/docs/ (Swagger UI with an Authorize button), docs/API.md in the repository.

pm.test("JWT carries role and username claims", () => { const payload = JSON.parse(atob(pm.response.json().access.split(".")[1].replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/"))); pm.expect(payload.role).to.eql("lecturer"); pm.expect(payload.username).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("lecturer_username")); });
// Assertions run after the response arrives (see the Test Results tab).
// Assertions run after the response arrives (see the Test Results tab).

pm.test("Is the lecturer, with stats", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.username).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("lecturer_username")); pm.expect(b.stats).to.include.keys("lectures", "questions", "upvotes_given", "upvotes_received"); });
// Assertions run after the response arrives (see the Test Results tab).
pm.test("Name changed, role is read-only here", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.first_name).to.eql("Renamed"); pm.expect(b.role).to.eql("lecturer"); });
// Assertions run after the response arrives (see the Test Results tab).

request.description: The refresh token is exchanged for a new pair; the old refresh token is blacklisted.

item.description: The student asks and edits; the lecturer upvotes and marks answered; role mistakes answer 403.

pm.test("Author is the student, can_edit true, can_answer false", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.author.username).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("student_username")); pm.expect(b.can_edit).to.be.true; pm.expect(b.can_answer).to.be.false; });
// Assertions run after the response arrives (see the Test Results tab).

pm.test("Page of 5, sorted by votes, none answered", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.results.length).to.be.at.most(5); pm.expect(b.count).to.be.at.least(50); const v = b.results.map(q => q.votes); for (let i = 1; i < v.length; i++) pm.expect(v[i-1]).to.be.at.least(v[i]); for (const q of b.results) pm.expect(q.is_answered).to.be.false; });
// Assertions run after the response arrives (see the Test Results tab).
